title: Caseback threading
description: Caseback threading capability for titanium components
processDescription: Thread rolling cold-forms threads by displacing material between two reciprocating or rotary dies, rather than cutting it away. Compressive residual stress at the thread root increases fatigue strength by 30–50% compared to cut threads, specifically for watch case. Precision watch case for Watchmaking, Consumer present unique challenges: Cosmetic surface finish (mirror polish, brush, or bead blast) with sub-mm feature detail. Material traceability from mill to finished case.
heatControl: Minimal heat generation due to fine finishing passes. Air blast for chip clearing sufficient; coolant not required for cosmetic finishing passes.
flatnessControl: Head flatness and perpendicularity within 0.05 mm per fastener standards. Die alignment verified with optical setup microscope.
capabilitiesDescription: Fastener manufacturing capability for Caseback threading, with cold forming, thread rolling, and 100% dimensional inspection.
